variants.specifics: Brackenford: Wenna, the miller's widow, pays potions up front to get back the key to her sluice gate from the Urchins of the old barrow.

offer.speaker: Wenna
offer.text:
Here you are at last, stranger. Halvard says my mill can wait until Corwin's gone. My mill can't wait!

The Urchins from the old barrow east of the ford took the key to my sluice gate. The wheel hasn't turned since. Take these potions now, they're yours whatever you say!

Will you get my key back from them?

refusal.speaker: Wenna
refusal.text: Not ready to take on Urchins yet, eh? Never mind, the job will keep. If you change your mind, just knock at the mill.

reminder.speaker: Wenna
reminder.text: Enough standing about. Go on, then!

completion.speaker: Wenna
completion.text: My key -- good, I've no time to talk just now.

journal.text: Recover Wenna's sluice key from the Urchins in the old barrow.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Wenna's sluice key from the Urchins in the old barrow.

variants.specifics: Druvak: Morva, a peddler packing up to leave, lost her enchanted lantern (already sold) to the Imps of the Old Shaft.

offer.speaker: Morva
offer.text:
While I was loading my cart, a pack of Imps came screeching up out of the Old Shaft -- and ran off with my enchanted lantern! It's already sold, and the buyer wants it tomorrow!

Odrik calls me a swindler, but he's never sold a thing in his life. Will you go down after those Imps and get it back?

refusal.speaker: Morva
refusal.text: Too scared of a few Imps? Then ask me again once you've grown a spine.

reminder.speaker: Morva
reminder.text: Still standing about? Those Imps could be smashing it to bits right now! My buyer won't wait forever!

completion.speaker: Morva
completion.text: Thank goodness, not a scratch on it! You'd make a fine peddler, lad. Take these boots, and I'm off before Skarn's Trolls come for the rest of my stock!

after.speaker: Morva
after.text: Thanks again. A poor peddler won't soon forget a kindness like yours...

journal.text: Recover Morva's enchanted lantern from the Imps in the Old Shaft.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Morva's enchanted lantern from the Imps in the Old Shaft.

variants.specifics: Okkum: Moribel's Moon Amulet was carried off by the Imps that keep creeping into her hut; she hands over her storeroom key.

offer.speaker: Moribel
offer.text:
Good evening, young sir. I expect you have come about my trouble.

Imps! The wretched things got into my hut and made off with my Moon Amulet! Dobbs went after them with a broom, but they keep creeping back up the pilings!

Here is the key to my storeroom -- they nest in there now. Will you go in and bring my amulet back?

refusal.speaker: Moribel
refusal.text: Don't dawdle on my ladder then. You haven't the nerve for Imps, I see. My amulet is as good as lost. Come back when you've found some courage.

reminder.speaker: Moribel
reminder.text: Dobbs -- the great lump -- says he heard them squabbling under the floorboards. Maybe that's where they hide my amulet!

completion.speaker: Moribel
completion.text:
Ah, there you are! I heard such squealing from the storeroom that I climbed down to look.

You have brought back the Moon Amulet! Remarkable! Those Imps have plagued this hut since the rains began! I shall hang it over my door tonight. We'll all sleep sounder with the little pests gone!

And this is for your trouble -- 100 gold pieces!

after.speaker: Moribel
after.text: Please, pull the hatch shut behind you. I'm still jumpy.

journal.text: Find Moribel's storeroom and recover the Moon Amulet.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Find Moribel's storeroom and recover the Moon Amulet.

variants.specifics: Thrane: Edda, the old woman who keeps watch from the east tower, wants her spyglass back from the Urchins of the Hollow.

offer.speaker: Edda
offer.text:
Ohh... is that another Urchin? No... a new face in Thrane, and a sturdy one.

What brings a young sir up all these stairs to a cranky old woman? Hmm, don't tell me... Lord Ostric wants you counting Trolls on his walls.

Well, I've no patience for Ostric and his walls, but you may as well make yourself useful. The Urchins of the Hollow crept in here last night and made off with my spyglass, and I'd wager my last tooth Gruthak paid them to do it!

Will you fetch it back for me? Here, take these potions. The Hollow is no place to go without them.

refusal.speaker: Edda
refusal.text: You haven't the nerve for Urchins. Come back when you've found some.

reminder.speaker: Edda
reminder.text: That was the last of my potions, I'm afraid. Mind yourself in the Hollow. Those Urchins are quick and spiteful lot.

completion.speaker: Edda
completion.text: My spyglass! Lord Ostric will be glad to know the east tower can see again. Here, a little gold for your trouble.

after.speaker: Edda
after.text: Brusk was up here asking after you. He said Lord Ostric would see you in the Great Hall.

journal.text: Recover Edda's spyglass from the Urchin Hollow.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover Edda's spyglass from the Urchin Hollow.

variants.specifics: Skellow: Jebba the fisherwoman's lantern was stolen by the Urchins, and Harbor Master Pell lets no boat out at night without a light.

offer.speaker: Jebba
offer.text:
The Urchins have a cave behind the smokehouse. They stole my lantern last night! Pell says no boat goes out after dark without a light. Not mine, not anybody's. And watch yourself. The little pests bite.

Will you bring it back?

refusal.speaker: Jebba
refusal.text: You haven't the nerve for Urchins, then.

reminder.speaker: Jebba
reminder.text: Off to the cave, lad! I can't fish without that lantern. Hurry! Pell won't bend his rule, not for me, not for anybody.

completion.speaker: Jebba
completion.text: My lantern!? From the Urchins? Truly? Take this, 60 in gold!

after.speaker: Jebba
after.text: The best fishing is out past the reeds. Just keep clear of Gannet Rock.

journal.text: Recover the stolen lantern from the Urchin cave behind the smokehouse and return it to Jebba.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the stolen lantern from the Urchin cave behind the smokehouse and return it to Jebba.

variants.specifics: Ostrel: Master Quillan wants the Ward Stone back from the Urchins who broke into the College vault.

offer.speaker: Quillan
offer.text:
Thunder and blazes! Are you the help Yarrick promised us?! Urchins got into the College vault in the storm, and they'd have carried off the whole of it if old Hobb hadn't come down with his lamp and screamed the house awake!

But in all the noise the thieves made off with the Ward Stone! Without it every ward on this town is down, and Vorlath can walk right in!

Never mind the silver they took, I want the Stone, and those Urchins made to pay! They've gone south, into the Sinkholes. Will you go after them, lad?

refusal.speaker: Quillan
refusal.text: Then return when you've found your nerve.

reminder.speaker: Quillan
reminder.text: That Stone is all that stands between us and Vorlath! Hurry!

completion.speaker: Quillan
completion.text:
In better times the bells of the College would ring all night for a deed like this! Well done! But Vorlath is still out there, and he won't wait for us.

This gold and this Spell Book are yours, with the thanks of the whole College! And the Library is open to you from now on. Tell the porter I said so.

journal.text: Recover the Ward Stone from the Urchins in the Sinkholes.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Ward Stone from the Urchins in the Sinkholes.

variants.specifics: Fort Krell: Pellim, the fort's old wizard, wants his staff back from the Trolls' ice caves, and pays with a free lesson.

offer.speaker: Pellim
offer.text:
Trouble, and more trouble! I need you to go up to the ice caves west of the fort. The Trolls carried off my staff to their den there.

They caught me on the north road with a sled of firewood and took nothing else! Ghrulg must want it badly.

Take this potion. Gunda's store has whatever else you need. Then hurry.

My lessons usually cost a pretty penny. Bring back my staff, and the next one is free! Will you go?

refusal.speaker: Pellim
refusal.text: You'd rather not, then. Sorry, but my spells are not given away for nothing.

reminder.speaker: Pellim
reminder.text: I've told you all I know. Off with you, and bring my staff home!

completion.speaker: Pellim
completion.text:
My staff! Well done! Here is the book I promised.

Read the words slowly when you cast this spell. If you stumble before it takes hold, it fizzles away! Once a beast is slowed, you may cut it down, or simply walk on past it.

after.speaker: Pellim
after.text: Thanks to you, an old fool has his staff again.

variants.specifics: Varnok: Ottla the toolsmith wants the Frost Tongs back from the Ogres who broke into her shop.

offer.speaker: Ottla
offer.text: Gorlak's brutes kicked in my door, broke my apprentice's fingers one by one, and carried the Frost Tongs off to their camp west of town! Are you up to knocking some Ogre heads and getting them back?

refusal.speaker: Ottla
refusal.text: Fine, the Tongs are lost then.

completion.speaker: Ottla
completion.text: Hmmm, the Frost Tongs, back where they belong. Take this ankh, it's the least I can do.

after.speaker: Ottla
after.text: Thank you. I suppose Dravic has found you work by now.

journal.text: Recover the Frost Tongs from the Ogre camp.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Recover the Frost Tongs from the Ogre camp.

variants.specifics: Tarrow: Widow Brisa of the mill; the Urchins of the Knobble caves ran off with her Warding Bell.

offer.speaker: Widow Brisa
offer.text:
Oh, please, help a poor widow!

Please, listen! Without my Warding Bell those Urchins will pick the mill clean, and me with it. Already the sacks are slit and the grain is all over the floor. Every night I hear them giggling down by the wheel, waiting for me to fall asleep.

I was hanging out the washing when a pack of them ran off with it. They live in the Knobble caves, east across the river.

Please, if you bring my bell back, I'm sure I can find some way to repay you. Will you do it?

refusal.speaker: Widow Brisa
refusal.text: I can see you've no time for a widow's bell! Off with you, then!

reminder.speaker: Widow Brisa
reminder.text: Have you got my bell back?

completion.speaker: Widow Brisa
completion.text: Thanks for my bell, and good luck up on Rook Hill. Take these potions with you.

after.speaker: Widow Brisa
after.text: You know, I've been wondering... maybe I'll hang that bell a little higher this time!

journal.text: Bring back the bell the Urchins stole from Widow Brisa's mill.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Bring back the bell the Urchins stole from Widow Brisa's mill.

variants.specifics: Belvik: Hesta, the miller's widow, wants her Amulet of Warding back from the Urchins' den under the Cairn of Olm.

offer.speaker: Hesta
offer.text:
Are you going after the Urchins who robbed my mill? If so, bring your own torch. Their den under the Cairn of Olm is full of old traps, and there may be Ogres in there now too.

Well? Will you fetch back my Amulet of Warding or won't you?

refusal.speaker: Hesta
refusal.text: Oh well... maybe I'll get used to Urchins in my flour!

completion.speaker: Hesta
completion.text: Right. It's not even scratched. Some gold, for thanks. Oh! And a potion besides. Off you go now.

after.speaker: Hesta
after.text: My warmest thanks once more for finding my Amulet!

journal.text: Bring back Hesta's Amulet of Warding from the Cairn of Olm.

journal_done.text: COMPLETED: Bring back Hesta's Amulet of Warding from the Cairn of Olm.
